BF16 projection cast precedes original BF16 channel scale
complete H3840 reduction and all matrix weights used in both terms

BF16max requires (p_hi+p_lo/16)*s instead of s*p_hi+s*p_lo/16 to reduce intermediate overflow risk
FP32 separate-dot accumulation changes reduction grouping
SDK host nearest-even FP8 model is not proof of NPU rounding/FTZ semantics
